text: The property had no detected fires from October 5 to November 3, 2026, based on satellite data (MODIS and VIIRS). However, there’s insufficient evidence for November 4 due to a data gap—sensors weren’t updated that day. Small, short, or cloud-obscured fires might have gone undetected even in covered periods. So while no fires were confirmed, we can’t guarantee the property was completely fire-free throughout the entire period.
